# Core v0.2.0 — 需求追溯與伴讀準備紀錄 / Requirement traceability preparation

## 繁體中文

### 範圍與版本

本工作包準備採納 [#24](https://github.com/jeffery777/engineering-workflow-core/issues/24) 的 finding 需求關係與 REQ-GAP，以及 [#26](https://github.com/jeffery777/engineering-workflow-core/issues/26) 的新增機制需求追溯。兩者新增契約義務，依 [版本方式](../../CHANGELOG.md) 準備下一個 minor `v0.2.0`。這是待審的來源版本準備紀錄，不證明已合併、發布、正式採用或安裝。正式發行前須再核對版本未占用及有效操作授權。

本版整合 [PR #28](https://github.com/jeffery777/engineering-workflow-core/pull/28) 的選用決策卡、十點讀法／階段索引，以及 review 決策與公開記錄伴讀。它們維持非權威、選用的說明；契約全文優先。[七案維護記錄](../maintenance/2026-10-31-consumer-feedback.md) 保留 #25 → #27 → #24 → #26 → #21 → #23 → #22 的評估次序、來源與未採納理由。#21 的嚴重度／強制停工／紀錄位置／規格失敗分類、#23 的 reviewer 工具限制，以及 #22 的強制公開掃描範圍仍未納入契約。#27 會新增最低義務的讀法亦未採納。

### 候選接受證據與限制

固定修改候選為 `87db5867fbed58c81e64f0c316168d537452425e`。Codex 與 Grok 各自 pin 完整十五檔，各完成一次相同九案的原生文字 eval，均為 9/9；兩端 n=1 的文字候選門檻已滿足。公開結果見 [Codex #362](https://github.com/jeffery777/codex-dev-skills/pull/362#issuecomment-6543978313) 與 [Grok #37](https://github.com/jeffery777/grok-build-dev-skills/pull/37#issuecomment-6543980433)。本版四份 contracts 必須與該固定候選逐 byte 相同，才可重用這一範圍的文字證據；清冊、伴讀與發行文件另行審查。若契約 bytes 改變，重新評估並補做受影響的兩端 eval。

文字案例涵蓋需求範圍內可修、缺口待人決定、使用者加入後的後續輪次、範圍外安全 blocker、無需求機制、既有 Core 義務，以及 severity／disposition／REQ-GAP 的保留。這些有限結果不證明完整 runtime 資格、工具隔離、普遍模型品質或正式 loader 採用。詳細本機執行證據由各接口保存在受控位置；本文件只記安全的來源、結果、限制與待辦。

### 清冊、完整性與後續採用

完整來源預期二十檔：十九份 Markdown 與原 LICENSE。保留 v0.1.1 的十四檔，加入三份 `docs/companion/` 文件、`docs/maintenance/2026-10-31-consumer-feedback.md`、`docs/maintenance/issue-24-26-candidate.md` 及本檔。具體清冊由最終 Git tree 讀回，逐檔記 raw SHA-256、bytes 與 Git mode；另列完整二十檔及十九份 Markdown 的集合 digest。使用 `sha256-path-tab-sha256-lf-v1`，依 UTF-8 path bytes 排序後串接 `path<TAB>sha256<LF>`。本檔不內嵌自身最終 revision 或 digest。

先對 v0.1.1、PR28 伴讀及固定修改候選分別確認原始 bytes／完整行序／mode 保留；含刪字、換字、空白／換行／Unicode 正規化、順序、missing／mode／type 負例。四契約與固定候選及 LICENSE 的 equality 另驗；新增句子與非權威說明由獨立 reviewer 審查。適用 code/docs/deep/security、必要比例掃描、完整 exact-head 及真實平台狀態分別記錄，未執行不記成功。

Core 仍只有 Markdown 文件與 LICENSE。正式合併及發行後，另核對 annotated tag object、其解參照的完整 merge revision、GitHub Release 身分／draft／prerelease 狀態，以及已審 tree／清冊／digests。Draft head 可作準備資料的 reviewed head，不能充當尚未知的 publication revision 或 tag object。未知欄位保持 pending，不填假 SHA、零值或分支名稱。

依 Core → Codex → Grok 的順序準備正式採用。建議 consumer 下一個 minor 為 Codex `0.36.0`、Grok `0.3.0`，正式準備時各自重核版本可用性及實際變更。採用包須更新完整 vendor／lock、獨立 trust anchors、allowlist／引用閉包、來源／notices、loading docs、組裝與版本相依。Codex 另保留當前 v0.1.1 為明確 installer history，驗 source／plugin／filesystem／Hermes 適用路徑、未知來源拒絕、upgrade／downgrade／rollback 與失敗不 promotion。兩端歷史候選 eval 的基準須固定為原 v0.1.1，不能跟著正式 vendor 前進。

未取得真實出版身分前，可完成固定準備快照、具體遷移資料及離線正反驗證，普通 loader／正式 vendor／產品 payload 維持原版。新版正式採用、consumer 發行、既有安裝更新是各自的後續操作；本紀錄不授權 merge、formal approval、tag／Release、部署或安裝。

保留 [MIT LICENSE](../../LICENSE)、[完整 notices](../provenance/upstream-notices.md) 與 [來源記錄](../provenance/source-map.md)。繁中為契約權威；依 ASD-STE100 原則編寫，尚未完成完整符合性驗證。

## English

### Scope and version

This packet prepares adoption of finding requirement relations and REQ-GAP from Issue #24, and mechanism-to-requirement traceability from Issue #26. They add contract duties, so the next minor preparation is `v0.2.0`. This source preparation record does not prove merge, publication, formal adoption or installation. Recheck version availability and action authority before publication.

The packet integrates PR28's optional decision cards, ten reading notes and stage index, and review/public-record companions. They remain non-authoritative and optional; the complete contracts control. The maintenance record preserves the requested seven-Issue order and reasons. It adopts none of Issue #21's new severity, mandatory stop, record-location or spec-failure duties, Issue #23's reviewer tool restriction, Issue #22's mandatory publication-scan scope, or Issue #27 readings that would add minimum duties.

### Candidate evidence and limits

Both consumers pinned all fifteen files of candidate `87db5867fbed58c81e64f0c316168d537452425e`. Each completed one actual nine-case text evaluation, with 9/9 outcomes. The dual-consumer text candidate gate is met within n=1 per consumer. The linked Codex and Grok comments record the public results. Reuse applies only if all four contracts are byte-identical to that candidate. Review inventory, companions and release records separately. Changed contract bytes require affected evaluations to be reassessed and rerun.

Cases cover in-scope fixes, undecided gaps, user-approved later scope, unrelated safety blockers, unsupported mechanisms, traceable Core duties, and retained severity/disposition/REQ-GAP fields. This does not qualify the full runtime, tool isolation, general model quality or formal loaders. Interfaces retain detailed local execution evidence in controlled storage; public records contain safe sources, results, limits and follow-up only.

### Inventory and adoption

The expected full source has twenty files: nineteen Markdown files and LICENSE. Keep v0.1.1's fourteen files; add the three companions, two maintenance records and this release record. Read the final inventory from Git and record per-file raw SHA-256, byte size and mode. Compute separate full-source and Markdown digests with `sha256-path-tab-sha256-lf-v1`, sorting UTF-8 paths and concatenating `path<TAB>sha256<LF>`. Do not embed this file's own final revision or digest.

Verify raw-byte, complete-line-order and mode preservation against v0.1.1, PR28 and the fixed modifying candidate independently, with corruption/type/mode negative cases and no normalization. Separately require candidate-contract and LICENSE equality. Independent review checks added sentences and optional guidance. Record applicable reviews, proportional scans, complete exact-head review and actual provider state; an unrun check is not success.

Core remains Markdown and LICENSE only. After separately authorized merge/publication, verify the annotated tag object, resolved full merge commit, GitHub Release identity/draft/prerelease state, and reviewed tree/inventory/digests. A draft head identifies preparation, not an unknown publication revision or tag object. Keep unknown fields pending; invent no SHA or publication identity.

Prepare in Core, Codex, then Grok order. Proposed next consumer minors are Codex `0.36.0` and Grok `0.3.0`, subject to each package's real changes and version checks. Update vendor/lock, independent anchors, allowlist/link closure, provenance/notices, loading docs, assembly and version dependencies. Codex must retain v0.1.1 as explicit installer history and test applicable source/plugin/filesystem/Hermes paths, unknown-source rejection, upgrade/downgrade/rollback and no promotion on failure. Historical candidate evaluations must keep their original v0.1.1 baseline rather than follow the ordinary vendor.

Before publication identity exists, fixed preparation snapshots, concrete migration data and offline positive/negative verification can proceed; ordinary loaders, formal vendors and product payloads stay unchanged. Formal adoption, consumer publication and installed-payload updates remain separate operations. This record grants no merge, formal approval, tag/Release, deployment or installation authority. Retain LICENSE, complete notices and provenance. Traditional Chinese is authoritative; full ASD-STE100 conformance is not verified.

<a id="preservation-reproduction"></a>

## 三基準逐字保留重跑／Three-baseline preservation reproduction

在含下列三個固定 Git objects 的 Core checkout 根目錄，以既有 Python 3 執行此離線範例；缺 object 時停止，不自動下載。它取代本版對原伴讀 equality 命令的使用，原歷史命令保留。Run this offline example with an existing Python 3 from the Core checkout root containing the three fixed objects. Missing objects stop the check without downloading. The original companion-only equality command remains a historical example, not this release's check. This is a documentation example, not a new Core executable or runtime gate.

```python
import os
from pathlib import Path
import stat
import subprocess

if not __debug__:
    raise SystemExit("Run this check without Python optimization")

BASES = (
    "7b66978a76597d09be1b55ad199a969b4ee59c0f",
    "709454e96c1b41362fe8840dc4e4dbc8d4fe2cf8",
    "87db5867fbed58c81e64f0c316168d537452425e",
)
ENV = dict(os.environ, GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS="1")

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", *args], env=ENV)

def retained(before, after, old_mode="100644", new_mode="100644", regular=True):
    if after is None or not regular or old_mode != new_mode:
        return False
    old, pos = before.splitlines(keepends=True), 0
    for line in after.splitlines(keepends=True):
        if pos < len(old) and line == old[pos]:
            pos += 1
    return pos == len(old)

sample = "甲 must stay.\nKeep  two spaces.\ncafé\n".encode()
positive = [sample, b"Added complete sentence.\n" + sample]
negative = [sample.replace("甲".encode(), b""), sample.replace(b"must", b"may"),
            sample.replace(b"  ", b" "), sample.replace(b"\n", b"\r\n"),
            sample.replace("é".encode(), "e\u0301".encode()), sample[:-1],
            b"".join(reversed(sample.splitlines(keepends=True)))]
assert all(retained(sample, value) for value in positive)
assert not any(retained(sample, value) for value in negative)
for value, mode, regular in [(None, "100644", True),
                             (sample, "100755", True),
                             (sample, "120000", False)]:
    assert not retained(sample, value, new_mode=mode, regular=regular)

for revision in BASES:
    count = 0
    for row in filter(None, git("ls-tree", "-rz", revision).split(b"\0")):
        meta, name = row.split(b"\t", 1)
        mode, kind, oid = meta.decode("ascii").split()
        path = Path(name.decode("utf-8"))
        info = path.lstat()
        regular = stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode)
        before = git("cat-file", "blob", oid)
        after = path.read_bytes() if regular else None
        actual_mode = "100755" if info.st_mode & 0o111 else "100644"
        assert kind == "blob" and retained(before, after, mode, actual_mode, regular), path
        if path.as_posix() == "LICENSE":
            assert before == after
        if revision == BASES[2] and path.as_posix().startswith("contracts/"):
            assert before == after
        count += 1
    print(revision, count, "baseline files retained")
print("PASS: four evaluated contracts and LICENSE exact; 2 positive / 10 negative cases")
```
